messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a staggered enable for 'sparrow-x1' this afternoon in the 18:00–19:00 UTC change window. Goal: enable canary, validate fallback ordering, then expand to 25%/50%/100% over 90m.
jen: SGTM. Can you paste the exact enable command we'll run so SRE can watch the right metrics?
mike: Also add the rollback triggers we agreed on (p95 > 450ms for 3 consecutive mins OR error-rate > 1%).
alex: Command we'll use (via deploy-bot):
```
deploy-bot enable-model --model=sparrow-x1 --variant=quant-q4_0 --canary=0.05 --pin-ttl=24h --fallback-order="sparrow-x1,sparrow-x0,llama-mini"
```
jen: Perfect. Notes:
- Canary traffic: 5% for first 15m, if stable -> 25% for next 30m, then 50% -> 100% as long as metrics OK.
- Pinning: canary pin for 24h to prevent auto-eviction during observation.
sam: ops-bot, please create a dashboard and set alerts for the triggers. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollouts
ops-bot: Dashboard created: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/d/rollout-sparrow-x1. Alerts: p95_latency_threshold=450ms, error_rate_threshold=1.0%, token_cost_regression_monitor (baseline vs canary).
deploy-bot: POST /rollout started by alex at 2065432200. Canary=5% -> variant sparrow-x1 (quant-q4_0). Canaries routed to region-us-west first.
mike: Monitoring note — validate tail latency distribution, not just p95. If p99 spikes > 800ms or error spikes > 2% at any point, initiate immediate rollback.
jen: Also check embeddings pipeline and reranking flows — sparrow-x1 has slightly different tokenization edge cases we saw in staging.
alex: Agreed. SRE to watch memory spikes and OOMs on dedicated pools; we saw a tiny KV cache regression in staging.
sam: I'll be watching logs and runbook. If rollback needed, what's the rollback command?
alex: Rollback command:
```
deploy-bot rollback-model --model=sparrow-x1 --to=previous --reason="auto-rollback or manual"
```
sam: Copy. Who has final go/no-go at each gate?
jen: I'll give go/no-go at the 15m and 45m checks. Mike will own the 75m check and final 100% handoff.
mike: Oncall SRE (me) will hit rollback if any alert fires. Tagging @sam for logs collection on rollback.
ops-bot: Alerting hooks wired to #eng-oncall and #incidents. Pager threshold set to 2% error sustained for 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at 2065432220. Routing to us-west. Observing initial latency samples.
jen: Seeing small increase in p50 (~10ms), p95 stable so far. No errors.
alex: Keep an eye on prompt-heavy traces — we saw longer KV cache lookups in staging for long contexts.
mike: 15m check: p95=420ms, error=0.3%, p99=720ms. No pager. Jen — your go?
jen: Go to 25%. deploy-bot, bump to 25%.
deploy-bot: Rollout update: canary -> 25% at 2065432320.
ops-bot: Noted. Watching memory and tail latencies.
jen: At 25% steady. p95=440ms, error=0.6%, costs +4% token CPU. Nothing critical.
mike: 45m check -> still inside thresholds. Move to 50%.
alex: If anything odd after 50% we should pause and run a short A/B sample comparing identical prompts across variants.
deploy-bot: Rollout update: 50% at 2065432345.
sam: I'm seeing two transient error spikes coincident with a regional deploy in us-west at 2065432350 — investigating correlation.
mike: p99 spike to 810ms for ~90s, error briefly at 1.8% but resolved. Given transient and correlation with infra deploy, I do NOT want to rollback yet. We pause expansion for 15m and observe.
jen: Agreed. Hold at 50% for 15m. Mike will re-evaluate.
alex: Logging the pause reason: transient infra noise in us-west during regional rollout. If error sustains above thresholds for 5m, we rollback.
ops-bot: Paused expansion timer started. We'll re-evaluate at 2065432480.
sam: If we need to force traffic away from us-west as a mitigation, can we route canary to us-east only?
mike: Yes — we can pin canary to region-us-east with deploy-bot reroute command.
jen: Thanks everyone. If all good after the pause, we'll proceed to 100% in next window. If not, rollback plan stands.
alex: Final note: add a quick note in release notes about fallback ordering change and pin TTL. I'll draft after finalization.
sam: Copy — will capture logs for postmortem if we rollback.
jen: Thanks — I'll post a short summary once we hit 100% or rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 50% by mike at 2065432365. Observing until 2065432480.
ops-bot: Alerts quieted; p99 returning below 800ms. Resume decision pending at re-eval.
mike: Re-eval at 2065432380: metrics stable. Proceed to 100% in next 10m if no new alerts. All clear from me.
alex: Thanks team. I'll follow up with release notes and pin summary. :thumbsup:
